201.en: She will show us her new painting after dinner.
201.zh: 晚饭后她会给我们看她的新画作。

202.en: I really miss my family when I travel abroad.
202.zh: 我在国外旅行时非常想念我的家人。

203.en: My father taught me how to drive a car.
203.zh: 我父亲教我如何开汽车。

204.en: You should try this new restaurant near the park.
204.zh: 你应该试试公园附近的这家新餐厅。

205.en: Her son is learning to play the piano.
205.zh: 她的儿子正在学习弹钢琴。

206.en: Oh shit, I forgot to lock the front door.

207.en: People all over the world love listening to music.
207.zh: 全世界的人都喜欢听音乐。

208.en: What the hell are you doing in my room?
208.zh: 你到底在我的房间里干什么？

209.en: The flowers in the garden are all dead now.
209.zh: 花园里的花现在全都枯死了。

210.en: We both bought the exact same pair of shoes.
210.zh: 我们俩买了完全一样的一双鞋。

211.en: The woman sitting there is my English teacher.
211.zh: 坐在那里的那位女士是我的英语老师。

212.en: I will visit my grandparents next weekend.
212.zh: 我下个周末会去看望我的祖父母。

213.en: I like to go jogging every morning before breakfast.
213.zh: 我喜欢每天早餐前去慢跑。

214.en: Is there anything else you want to tell me?
214.zh: 你还有什么别的事想告诉我吗？

215.en: It has been a long and trying week at work.
215.zh: 这一周工作又长又难熬。

216.en: Too much stress can slowly kill your happiness.
216.zh: 太多的压力会慢慢扼杀你的快乐。

217.en: Can you guess how many books are on that shelf?
217.zh: 你能猜出那个书架上有多少本书吗？

218.en: Is that a real diamond or just a fake one?

219.en: Please hold my bag while I tie my shoes.
219.zh: 我系鞋带时请帮我拿着包。

220.en: Someone left a note on my desk this morning.
220.zh: 今天早上有人在我桌上留了一张便条。

221.en: You should be proud of yourself for finishing the race.
221.zh: 你应该为自己跑完了比赛而感到骄傲。

222.en: She shook her head and said no to the offer.
222.zh: 她摇了摇头，拒绝了这个提议。

223.en: A true friend will always tell you the truth.
223.zh: 真正的朋友总会对你说实话。

224.en: Today is the first day of our summer vacation.
224.zh: 今天是我们暑假的第一天。

225.en: My mom makes the best dumplings in the world.
225.zh: 我妈妈做的饺子是全世界最好吃的。

226.en: They found a lost dog on the street yesterday.
226.zh: 他们昨天在街上发现了一只走失的狗。

227.en: I spent the whole afternoon reading this interesting novel.
227.zh: 我花了整个下午读这本有趣的小说。

228.en: We plan to move to a bigger house next month.
228.zh: 我们计划下个月搬到一个更大的房子。

229.en: I cannot finish this work without your help.
229.zh: 没有你的帮助我无法完成这项工作。

230.en: This is the best coffee I have ever tasted.
230.zh: 这是我尝过的最好的咖啡。

231.en: She got a new job at a software company.
231.zh: 她在一家软件公司找到了一份新工作。

232.en: We are going to watch a movie together tonight.
232.zh: 我们今晚要一起去看电影。

234.en: Let us solve this problem together as a team.
234.zh: 让我们一起作为一个团队来解决这个问题。

235.en: The garden looks pretty with all these colorful flowers.
235.zh: 花园里开满五颜六色的花，看起来很漂亮。

236.en: Are you ready to start the exam now?
236.zh: 你现在准备好开始考试了吗？

237.en: Wait a minute, I need to find my keys.
237.zh: 等一下，我需要找到我的钥匙。

238.en: How many people came to the party last night?
238.zh: 昨晚有多少人来了派对？

239.en: His wife is a doctor at the city hospital.
239.zh: 他的妻子是市医院的一名医生。

240.en: I have only been to Beijing once in my life.
240.zh: 我这辈子只去过北京一次。

241.en: Please be quiet while the baby is sleeping.
241.zh: 宝宝睡觉的时候请保持安静。

242.en: It does not matter if you made a small mistake.
242.zh: 你犯个小错误没关系的。

243.en: Most students enjoy the summer holiday very much.
243.zh: 大多数学生都非常享受暑假。

244.en: Fuck, I spilled coffee all over my new shirt.
244.zh: 该死，我把咖啡洒得新衬衫上到处都是。

245.en: That is a great idea for our school project.
245.zh: 那对我们的学校项目来说是个好主意。

246.en: I have not finished my homework yet.
246.zh: 我还没有完成我的作业。

247.en: Please raise your hand if you know the answer.
247.zh: 如果你知道答案，请举手。

248.en: She had a big smile on her face all day.
248.zh: 她一整天脸上都挂着灿烂的笑容。

249.en: He made an excuse for being late to class.
249.zh: 他为上课迟到找了个借口。

250.en: My family has dinner together every Sunday evening.
250.zh: 我的家人每个周日晚上都一起吃晚饭。

251.en: The small island became a safe haven for sailors.
251.zh: 这个小岛成了水手们的安全避难所。

252.en: I made this cake all by myself this morning.
252.zh: 今天早上我完全靠自己做了这个蛋糕。

253.en: She can run ten kilometers without getting tired.
253.zh: 她能跑十公里而不感到累。

254.en: Children love to play games in the park.
254.zh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里玩游戏。

255.en: I used to live in Shanghai when I was young.
255.zh: 我小时候曾经住在上海。

256.en: Let us meet at the library after school today.
256.zh: 我们今天放学后在图书馆见面吧。

257.en: My grandparents live in a small village near the mountains.
257.zh: 我的祖父母住在山附近的一个小村庄。

258.en: You can use my phone to call your parents.
258.zh: 你可以用我的手机给你父母打电话。

259.en: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
259.zh: 我以前从未见过如此美丽的日落。

260.en: She felt very happy when she received the gift.
260.zh: 她收到礼物时感到非常开心。

261.en: Please bring your notebook to class every day.
261.zh: 请每天把你的笔记本带到课堂上来。

262.en: This year has been full of surprises and changes.
262.zh: 这一年充满了惊喜和变化。

263.en: Somebody is knocking on the door right now.

264.en: Everybody in our class passed the final exam.
264.zh: 我们班每个人都通过了期末考试。

265.en: The school is only five minutes from my home.
265.zh: 学校离我家只有五分钟的路程。

266.en: Let us start the meeting at ten o'clock sharp.
266.zh: 我们十点整开始开会吧。

267.en: I have five apples and three oranges in my bag.
267.zh: 我包里有五个苹果和三个橙子。

268.en: Could you please open the window to let fresh air in?
268.zh: 请打开窗户让新鲜空气进来好吗？

269.en: The kid was excited to go to the zoo.
269.zh: 那个小孩很兴奋能去动物园。

270.en: We will discuss the plan at the meeting tomorrow.
270.zh: 我们明天会议上会讨论这个计划。

271.en: There is an old saying that practice makes perfect.

272.en: I have known her since we were in primary school.
272.zh: 我从小学起就认识她了。

273.en: Please close the door quietly when you leave the room.
273.zh: 你离开房间时请轻轻关上门。

274.en: I like to watch the stars at night in summer.
274.zh: 我喜欢在夏天的夜晚看星星。

275.en: I have already finished reading this thick book.
275.zh: 我已经读完了这本厚书。

276.en: I hope the weather is sunny for our picnic tomorrow.
276.zh: 我希望明天我们野餐时天气晴朗。

277.en: We need to find a solution to this math problem.
277.zh: 我们需要找到这道数学题的解法。

278.en: My father runs a small business in the city center.
278.zh: 我父亲在市中心经营一家小生意。

279.en: She prefers to study alone in the quiet library.
279.zh: 她更喜欢独自在安静的图书馆学习。

280.en: Learning a new language is hard but very rewarding.
280.zh: 学习一门新语言很困难，但非常有收获。

281.en: Actually, I have never been to that museum before.
281.zh: 实际上，我以前从未去过那个博物馆。

282.en: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable here.

283.en: Both of my parents are teachers at a university.
283.zh: 我父母两人都是大学的老师。

284.en: Only a few students remembered to bring their books today.
284.zh: 今天只有几个学生记得带书。

285.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave the office.
285.zh: 你离开办公室时请关灯。

286.en: I waited at the station until the train arrived.
286.zh: 我在车站一直等到火车到达。

287.en: The heavy rain caused a flood in the small town.
287.zh: 大雨在这个小镇引发了洪水。

288.en: My older brother taught me how to ride a bike.
288.zh: 我哥哥教我如何骑自行车。

289.en: This is the second time I have visited this city.
289.zh: 这是我第二次访问这座城市。

290.en: There is too much stuff on my desk right now.
290.zh: 我的桌子上现在有太多东西了。

291.en: I like to put honey in my tea every morning.
291.zh: 我喜欢每天早上在茶里加蜂蜜。

292.en: The cat is sleeping under the big wooden table.
292.zh: 猫正在大木桌下面睡觉。

293.en: I have four close friends from my college days.
293.zh: 我有四个大学时代的亲密朋友。

294.en: I will call you later when I get home.
294.zh: 我到后会晚一点给你打电话。

295.en: The lord of the castle welcomed all his guests warmly.
295.zh: 城堡的主人热情地欢迎了所有的客人。

296.en: I need some quiet time for deep thinking today.
296.zh: 我今天需要一些安静的时间来深思。

297.en: The young couple bought their first apartment last month.
297.zh: 那对年轻夫妇上个月买了他们的第一套公寓。

298.en: Reading is an important part of my daily routine.
298.zh: 阅读是我日常生活中重要的一部分。

299.en: In case of fire, please use the emergency exit.
299.zh: 万一发生火灾，请使用紧急出口。

300.en: The movie has a surprising twist at the end.
300.zh: 这部电影在结尾有一个令人惊讶的转折。

301.en: I visited this temple many years ago with my family.
301.zh: 许多年前我和家人一起参观过这座寺庙。

302.en: My heart beats faster when I see her smile.
302.zh: 当我看到她的笑容时，我的心跳会加快。

303.en: Try not to worry about things you cannot control.
303.zh: 尽量不要为你无法控制的事情担心。

304.en: The sunset over the ocean was truly beautiful tonight.
304.zh: 今晚海上的日落真是美极了。

305.en: She will probably arrive at the airport around noon.
305.zh: 她大概会在中午左右到达机场。

306.en: Please check your answers before you hand in the paper.
306.zh: 交卷前请检查你的答案。

307.en: Damn, I left my wallet at home this morning.
307.zh: 该死，我今天早上把钱包落在家里了。

308.en: I will never forget the first day of high school.
308.zh: 我永远不会忘记高中的第一天。

309.en: The doctor told me to drink more water every day.
309.zh: 医生告诉我要每天多喝水。

310.en: I stayed up late to finish my history report.
310.zh: 我熬夜到很晚才完成我的历史报告。

311.en: Each student needs to bring a notebook to the class.
311.zh: 每个学生都需要带一本笔记本到课堂上。

312.en: I hope you get well soon and come back.
312.zh: 我希望你早日康复，快点回来。

313.en: She kept her word and returned the money on time.
313.zh: 她信守诺言，按时归还了钱。

314.en: The baseball player hit the ball very far today.
314.zh: 那个棒球选手今天把球打得很远。

315.en: Some flowers die in winter and bloom again in spring.
315.zh: 有些花在冬天枯萎，春天又重新开放。

316.en: Please shut the door behind you when you go out.
316.zh: 你出去的时候请随手关门。

317.en: She is crazy about playing the guitar every evening.
317.zh: 她对每天晚上弹吉他非常痴迷。

318.en: This math problem is actually very easy to solve.
318.zh: 这道数学题其实很容易解。

319.en: We made a deal to split the payment equally.
319.zh: 我们达成了协议，平摊费用。

320.en: I usually eat lunch at twelve o'clock every day.
320.zh: 我通常每天十二点吃午饭。

321.en: Could I use your phone to make a quick call?
321.zh: 我能用你的电话快速打一个电话吗？

322.en: Please set the table before our guests arrive tonight.
322.zh: 请在客人今晚到达之前摆好餐具。

323.en: Nobody knew the answer to the difficult question.
323.zh: 没有人知道那个难题的答案。

324.en: This book is mine, not yours, so please return it.
324.zh: 这本书是我的，不是你的，所以请还给我。

325.en: The small town is famous for its hot spring baths.
325.zh: 这个小镇以其温泉浴场而闻名。

326.en: She is afraid of speaking in front of large crowds.
326.zh: 她害怕在很多人面前讲话。

327.en: Is it true that you are moving to New York?
327.zh: 你要搬到纽约去，这是真的吗？

328.en: I need to pay the electricity bill before Friday.
328.zh: 我需要在周五之前交电费。

329.en: Is there anyone who can help me carry these boxes?
329.zh: 有人能帮我搬这些箱子吗？

330.en: He worked his ass off to finish the project on time.
330.zh: 他拼命工作才按时完成了项目。

331.en: The whole team is against that unfair new rule.
331.zh: 整个团队都反对那条不公平的新规定。

332.en: Would you like something cool to drink on this hot day?
332.zh: 这么热的天你想喝点什么凉的吗？

333.en: I have only read half of this interesting novel.
333.zh: 我只读了这本有趣小说的一半。

334.en: I like to read a book before going to sleep.
334.zh: 我喜欢在睡觉前读一本书。

335.en: The most important point is to be honest with yourself.
335.zh: 最重要的一点是对自己诚实。

336.en: What will happen if it rains on our picnic day?
336.zh: 如果野餐那天会下雨，会发生什么呢？

337.en: He used a jack to lift the heavy car easily.
337.zh: 他用千斤顶轻松地把那沉重的汽车抬了起来。

338.en: You can wear whatever you like to the casual dinner.
338.zh: 去便餐聚会你穿什么都可以。

339.en: She can speak English, and she also speaks Japanese well.
339.zh: 她会说英语，而且日语也说得好。

340.en: She hurt her knee while playing basketball at school.
340.zh: 她在学校打篮球时伤了膝盖。

341.en: Please write down your phone number on this paper.
341.zh: 请把你的电话号码写在这张纸上。

342.en: Please cut the cake into eight equal pieces for everyone.
342.zh: 请把蛋糕切成八等份分给每个人。

343.en: You need to change your bad habits to stay healthy.
343.zh: 你需要改变坏习惯才能保持健康。

344.en: I drink eight glasses of water every single day.

345.en: Oh dear, I forgot my umbrella on the bus again.
345.zh: 哎呀，我又把雨伞忘在公交车上了。

346.en: Take every chance to learn something new and grow.
346.zh: 抓住每一个机会学习新东西并成长。

347.en: Everyone in the room was surprised by the sudden news.
347.zh: 房间里的每个人都对这个突然的消息感到惊讶。

348.en: The fire spread quickly through the old wooden building.
348.zh: 大火迅速蔓延穿过了那座老旧的木制建筑。

349.en: I wish I could travel around the world someday.
349.zh: 我希望有一天能环游世界。

350.en: The airport is not too far from the city center.
350.zh: 机场离市中心不是很远。

351.en: He built this bookshelf all by himself last weekend.
351.zh: 他上周末完全靠自己做了这个书架。

352.en: The cat licked its paw and then fell asleep quickly.
352.zh: 猫舔了舔自己的爪子，然后很快就睡着了。

353.en: Could I have a little bit more rice, please?
353.zh: 我能再要一点点米饭吗？

354.en: The price of this phone is too high for me.
354.zh: 这部手机的价格对我来说太高了。

355.en: The death of the old tree made everyone feel sad.
355.zh: 那棵老树的死亡让每个人都感到难过。

356.en: I am tired, but I will finish this work anyway.
356.zh: 我累了，但无论如何我会完成这项工作。

357.en: We are having a birthday party for my sister tomorrow.
357.zh: 我们明天要为我的妹妹举办一个生日派对。

358.en: The police caught the thief near the train station.
358.zh: 警察在火车站附近抓住了那个小偷。

359.en: I cannot stand the noise from the construction site anymore.
359.zh: 我再也受不了建筑工地的噪音了。

360.en: I usually sleep for about eight hours every night.
360.zh: 我通常每晚睡大约八个小时。

361.en: Though it was raining, we still went outside to play.
361.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去玩了。

362.en: We had so much fun at the beach last weekend.
362.zh: 我们上周在海滩玩得非常开心。

363.en: My favorite video game takes about forty hours to finish.
363.zh: 我最喜欢的电子游戏大约需要四十小时才能通关。

364.en: There is a bookstore on the other side of the street.
364.zh: 街道的另一边有一家书店。

365.en: I wake up at six every morning to go jogging.
365.zh: 我每天早上六点起床去慢跑。

366.en: He took a beautiful shot of the sunset with his camera.
366.zh: 他用相机拍下了一张美丽的日落照片。

367.en: Please close your eyes and make a wish now.
367.zh: 现在请闭上你的眼睛许个愿吧。

368.en: I am having trouble understanding this difficult grammar rule.
368.zh: 我很难理解这个困难的语法规则。

369.en: Let us take a short break and have some tea.
369.zh: 我们休息一下喝点茶吧。

370.en: Is there anybody here who can speak Chinese?

371.en: Wait a moment, I need to grab my coat first.
371.zh: 等一下，我需要先拿我的外套。

372.en: You look tired, please sit down and take a rest.
372.zh: 你看起来很累，请坐下休息一会儿。

373.en: The young lady helped the old man cross the street.
373.zh: 那位年轻的女士帮助老人过了马路。

374.en: He is the kindest person I have ever met.
374.zh: 他是我遇到过的最善良的人。

375.en: Education is the best means to a better future.
375.zh: 教育是通向更美好未来的最佳途径。

376.en: Let us take a walk in the park after dinner.
376.zh: 我们晚饭后去公园散步吧。

377.en: My grandmother told me a wonderful story from her childhood.
377.zh: 我奶奶给我讲了一个她童年的精彩故事。

378.en: This movie is quite different from what I expected.
378.zh: 这部电影和我期待的完全不同。

379.en: A young couple moved into the house next to ours.
379.zh: 一对年轻夫妇搬进了我们隔壁的房子。

380.en: Please stand in a straight line and wait quietly.
380.zh: 请排成一条直线，安静等待。

381.en: You should at least call your mother once a week.
381.zh: 你至少应该每周给你妈妈打一次电话。

382.en: My husband and I have been married for ten years.
382.zh: 我和我的丈夫已经结婚十年了。

383.en: The captain of our team gave a great speech.
383.zh: 我们队的队长做了一次很棒的演讲。

384.en: My brother told me a very funny joke at lunch.
384.zh: 我哥哥在午饭时给我讲了一个非常好笑的笑话。

385.en: I hate getting up early on cold winter mornings.
385.zh: 我讨厌在寒冷的冬天早晨早起。

386.en: People from different cultures have different customs and habits.
386.zh: 来自不同文化的人有不同的风俗习惯。

387.en: The police officer carried a gun for his own safety.
387.zh: 那个警察为了自身安全携带了一把枪。

388.en: It is almost time for dinner, so wash your hands.
388.zh: 差不多该吃晚饭了，去洗洗手吧。

389.en: Can you speak a little slower so I can understand?
389.zh: 你能说慢一点吗，这样我能听懂。

390.en: We had a wonderful dinner at a nice Italian restaurant.
390.zh: 我们在一家不错的意大利餐厅吃了一顿美妙的晚餐。

391.en: Do you have any question about today's history lesson?
391.zh: 你对今天的历史课有什么问题吗？

392.en: It is important to drink enough water in the summer.
392.zh: 夏天喝足够的水是很重要的。

393.en: There is a beautiful garden behind our school building.
393.zh: 我们教学楼后面有一个美丽的花园。

394.en: I have to go to the post office this afternoon.
394.zh: 我今天下午得去一趟邮局。

395.en: I like to read in bed before falling asleep.
395.zh: 我喜欢睡前在床上看书。

396.en: It is warmer inside the house than outside right now.

397.en: Regular exercise is good for both body and mind.
397.zh: 经常锻炼对身体和心灵都有好处。

398.en: Is this red pen yours or does it belong to Tom?
398.zh: 这支红笔是你的还是汤姆的？

399.en: To tell the truth, I did not like the movie.
399.zh: 说实话，我不喜欢那部电影。

400.en: The difference between these two colors is very small.
400.zh: 这两种颜色之间的差别非常小。
